description_en: Queries the number of historical online users for a live stream
description_zh: 调用DescribeLiveStreamHistoryUserNum查询直播流历史在线人数
kebab_example: aliyun live describe-live-stream-history-user-num --domain-name example.com --app-name liveApp0000 --stream-name liveStream0000 --start-time 2017-12-21T08:00:00Z --end-time 2017-12-22T08:00:00Z --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeLiveStreamHistoryUserNum

parameters.help_en: The name of the application to which the live stream belongs. You can view the application name on the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/197397.html page of the ApsaraVideo Live console
parameters.help_zh: 直播流所属应用名称。您可在https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/197397.html页面查看AppName
parameters.name: app_name

parameters.help_en: The name of the live stream. You can view the stream name on the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/197397.html page of the ApsaraVideo Live console
parameters.name: stream_name

parameters.help_en:
The beginning of the time range to query. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC.

You can query data in the last 30 days
parameters.help_zh: 起始时间。格式为：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ（UTC时间）。 支持最大的查询范围是最近30天
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en:
The end of the time range to query. The end time must be later than the start time. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC.

The time range specified by the StartTime and EndTime parameters cannot exceed one day. The end time must not be later than the current time
parameters.help_zh: 结束时间。需晚于开始时间。格式为：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ（UTC时间）。 StartTime和EndTime时间间隔在一天内，且EndTime不超过当前时间
parameters.name: end_time
